name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
description: Comprehensive cloud platform with extensive AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, and Comprehend. Strong compliance posture with numerous certifications and global region availability.
key_capabilities: Amazon Bedrock for foundation model access
SageMaker for ML model training and deployment
AWS AI Services (Comprehend, Rekognition, Textract)
IAM and KMS for fine-grained access control and encryption
CloudTrail for audit logging
AWS Artifact for compliance documentation
Data residency controls via region selection
pros: Largest number of global regions and availability zones
Most extensive compliance certification portfolio (SOC, ISO, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR)
Mature AI/ML ecosystem with Bedrock supporting multiple foundation models
Strong data residency controls with dedicated sovereign cloud options
Comprehensive audit and governance tooling (Config, CloudTrail, Security Hub)
cons: Complex pricing model can lead to unexpected costs
Steep learning curve due to breadth of services
Some AI services have region-specific availability limitations
Vendor lock-in risk with proprietary service integrations
compliance_notes: AWS holds certifications including SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018, HIPAA, FedRAMP High, PCI DSS, GDPR compliance tools, C5 (Germany), IRAP (Australia), MTCS (Singapore). AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to compliance reports.

name: Microsoft Azure
description: Enterprise-focused cloud platform with deep integration into Microsoft ecosystem. Offers Azure OpenAI Service for GPT model access with enterprise security and compliance controls.
key_capabilities: Azure OpenAI Service for GPT-4 and other models
Azure Machine Learning for model lifecycle management
Azure AI Services (Cognitive Services, Document Intelligence)
Azure Policy and Blueprints for governance automation
Microsoft Entra ID for identity and access management
Azure Monitor and Log Analytics for observability
Sovereign cloud offerings (Azure Government, Azure China)
pros: Native Azure OpenAI Service provides enterprise-grade GPT access with data privacy guarantees
Strong enterprise integration with Microsoft 365 and Active Directory
Comprehensive compliance offerings including government-specific clouds
Built-in responsible AI tooling (Fairness, Interpretability, Error Analysis)
Extensive hybrid cloud capabilities with Azure Arc
cons: Azure OpenAI Service requires separate application and approval process
Some regions have limited AI service availability
Complex licensing when combined with Microsoft 365 enterprise agreements
Documentation can be fragmented across multiple portals
compliance_notes: Azure holds certifications including SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018, HIPAA, FedRAMP High, PCI DSS, GDPR compliance tools, BSI C5, IRAP, MTCS, ENS (Spain), G-Cloud (UK). Azure Government provides isolated environment for US government workloads.

name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
description: Cloud platform with strong AI/ML heritage, offering Vertex AI for model development and deployment, and access to Gemini models. Known for data analytics capabilities and open-source friendly approach.
key_capabilities: Vertex AI for model training, tuning, and deployment
Gemini API for foundation model access
BigQuery ML for SQL-based machine learning
Cloud AI Platform Notebooks for development
VPC Service Controls for data perimeter security
Cloud Audit Logs for compliance monitoring
Assured Workloads for regulatory compliance
pros: Leading AI research heritage with cutting-edge model capabilities
Strong data analytics integration (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub)
Competitive pricing with sustained use discounts
Open-source friendly with support for TensorFlow, JAX, and Kubernetes
Assured Workloads provides compliance guardrails for regulated industries
cons: Smaller global region footprint compared to AWS and Azure
Enterprise support and account management less mature than competitors
Some compliance certifications lag behind AWS and Azure in certain regions
compliance_notes: GCP holds certifications including SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018, HIPAA, FedRAMP High, PCI DSS, GDPR compliance tools, BSI C5, IRAP. Assured Workloads provides compliance controls for US government (IL4/IL5), EU, Canada, and Australia.
